newGoalReviewer.category: New goal: exact Chinese correction delta

newGoalReviewer.scope: This CLI session only; no nested model reported or authorized; platform overhead unavailable

priorTaskReviewer.category: Prior task: Portuguese independent review completed before this goal; reported separately, excluded from current goal subtotal

coordinator.scope: Measured mixed current-goal coordination, direct authoring, validation and integration after baseline; pure orchestration cannot be separated

subsets: Cached input is a subset of input; reasoning output is a subset of output. Total=input+output; no subset is added twice.
money: Not requested; no monetary charge inferred
currentGoalMeasuredSubtotalScope: Partial mixed coordinator measurement plus one fresh terminal reviewer, each counted once; excludes prior-task workers and unknown/unmeasured tails
